evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected method identities, ordinary raw ABI and typed native receiver field; complete owned instruction partitions.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The admitted DynamicScene ready entry requests the Boolean getter on the selected GamePlayer.mission receiver; the getter's non-replacement return is constant true and does not read a readiness field.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Both named IsPatched checks return false, named get_player and mission receiver are valid nonnull references, opaque initialization helpers return normally, and normal Win64 frame/call rules hold.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual invocation, player/mission instance selection, patch replacement behavior and live readiness remain unresolved. No stored readiness state is established.
